info.name: ShareMarketBazaar API
info.description:
End-to-end tests for ShareMarketBazaar.

1. Start the app (`mvn spring-boot:run`).
2. Run folders 0→5 in order (Collection Runner, or one by one).

See TESTING_GUIDE.md for full details. Symbols are generated uniquely on every run, so the collection is re-runnable without restarting the app.

item.description: Confirm the application is up before testing.

item.name: 2. Indicator Verification (deterministic maths)
item.description: Small hand-checkable data sets proving each indicator and the per-ticker Factory config. Run each pair top-to-bottom.

request.description:
Pre-request script sends tick #1 (price 100, volume 100) to a fresh unique symbol; this request sends tick #2 (110, volume 300).

VWAP = (100*100 + 110*300) / 400 = **107.5**.

exec: const symbol = 'VW' + Date.now().toString().slice(-7);   // unique per run
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ symbol: symbol, price: ticks[i][0], volume: ticks[i][1] }) }
if (err || res.code !== 202) console.error('Tick ' + i + ' failed', err || res.text());

request.description: **Expect:** `vwap` 107.5, `tickCount` 2, no EMA/RSI yet (they need 27 / 15 ticks), signal HOLD with reason *Warming up*.

item.name: 2.3 Load RSI data (16 steadily rising ticks)

request.description: 15 ticks (100..114) are sent by the pre-request script, this request sends the 16th (115). Prices only go up, so average loss = 0 and **RSI = 100**.

exec: const symbol = 'RS' + Date.now().toString().slice(-7);   // unique per run
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ symbol: symbol, price: ticks[i][0], volume: ticks[i][1] }) }
if (err || res.code !== 202) console.error('Tick ' + i + ' failed', err || res.text());

request.description: **Expect:** `rsi14` = 100, RSI bias `BEARISH` (overbought), EMA still absent.

item.name: 2.5 Per-ticker config: RELIANCE has no VWAP

request.description: `application.yml` overrides RELIANCE to `[EMA_CROSSOVER, RSI]`. The **Factory** therefore never builds the VWAP strategy for it.
**Expect:** no `vwap` field and no `VWAP` entry in `indicators` (Factory pattern in action). Compare with 2.2 where VWAP is present.

item.name: 3. Signal Generation (EMA crossover + RSI guard)
item.description: Three scenarios: BUY, SELL, and a crossover blocked by the RSI guard. Each 'Load' request pre-sends the earlier ticks, then sends the final tick that creates the crossover.

request.description: Prices fall 0.5/tick for 30 ticks (EMA12 < EMA26) then rise 0.5/tick. The final tick (**992.5**) makes EMA12 cross above EMA26 while RSI stays below 70.

exec: const symbol = 'BUY' + Date.now().toString().slice(-7);   // unique per run
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ symbol: symbol, price: ticks[i][0], volume: ticks[i][1] }) }
if (err || res.code !== 202) console.error('Tick ' + i + ' failed', err || res.text());

request.description: **Expect:** signal `BUY`, `rsi14` ≈ 67.1, `stopLoss` ≈ 977.6125, `targetPrice` ≈ 1022.275. Saves `lastPrice` for the Orders folder.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));const near = (a, b, tol=0.02) => Math.abs(a - b) <= tol;
pm.test('golden cross flagged on latest tick', () => pm.expect(j.indicators.EMA_CROSSOVER.values.crossover).to.eql(1));
pm.collectionVariables.set('lastPrice', j.lastPrice);   // used by the Orders folder

request.description: Only actionable signals (BUY/SELL) are stored; HOLD is not. **Expect:** exactly one BUY.
Mirror image: prices rise then fall. Final tick (**1007.5**) creates a death cross with RSI above 30.

item.name: 3.7 Verify crossover blocked by RSI guard

request.description: **Expect:** crossover = 1 but signal is **HOLD** with reason *Bullish EMA cross blocked by RSI guard*.

exec: pm.test('reason cites the RSI guard', () => pm.expect(j.signal.reason).to.include('blocked by RSI guard'));

request.description: **Expect:** `[]` — HOLD signals are never persisted (unless `emit-hold` streaming is enabled, which only affects WebSocket, not the DB).
